findings.claim: The run 20261109T232006 bullet still says 18 items were executed (16 on SQLite, 2 on OpenJDK) and the other 12 rest on documentation, while the refreshed method table now lists 20 executed items (18 SQLite incl. 03 and 24, 2 OpenJDK) and 11 documentation-checked ids (16 split across both). The bullet is historically true for that run but reads as the current method split, so an instructor reconciling the record sees 18/12 against 20/11 without being told which is current.
findings.recommendation: Mark the 18/12 bullet as the state at run 20261109T232006, or add one sentence saying items 03 and 24 moved to executed in run 20261110T074849Z and the table is the current split.

findings.claim: v5 delivers items in level order (6 Apply, 21 Analyze, 3 Evaluate; consistent with the map's levels: Apply 05,07,08,11,15,19; Evaluate 03,04,28) while planned ids stay numbered in course order. Learners are not misled (blueprint instructions make no ordering claim), but the record does not state that delivered question numbers no longer equal planned ids, so an instructor mapping a platform question number to a coverage-map item (e.g. for item analysis or a learner query) could mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Add one line noting that delivered position differs from the planned id under v5 and that the id-to-position mapping is kept with the private bank (value-free, no keys).
